scripts.dev:proxy: docker rm -f layai-caddy >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker run --rm --name layai-caddy -p 3000:3000 -e BACKEND_UPSTREAM=host.docker.internal:8080 -e STUDENT_UPSTREAM=host.docker.internal:3001 -e LECTURER_UPSTREAM=host.docker.internal:3002 -e ADMIN_UPSTREAM=host.docker.internal:3003 -v "$PWD/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro" caddy:2-alpine
scripts.dev:student: cd apps/student-web && PORT=3001 npm run dev
scripts.dev:lecturer: cd apps/lecturer-web && PORT=3002 npm run dev
scripts.dev:admin: cd apps/admin-web && PORT=3003 npm run dev
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:proxy" "npm run dev:student" "npm run dev:lecturer" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run dev:proxy" "cd apps/student-web && PORT=3001 npm start" "cd apps/lecturer-web && PORT=3002 npm start" "cd apps/admin-web && PORT=3003 npm start" "cd apps/backend && BACKEND_PORT=${BACKEND_PORT:-8080} go run ./cmd/api/main.go"
